ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 65-70% high-intensity white pixels and 30-35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous fields on both lateral lobes. A central low-intensity black region extends from the peduncle base to the median notch, tapering outwards into the lobes. Distinct small-scale dark circular clusters (mottling) are present in the mid-lower regions of both white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 55 degrees; depth is significant, roughly 15% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed across the entire trailing edge boundary. A prominent high-amplitude negative deviation (notch) is visible on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe, near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a generally convex curve from the notch to the distal tips, with a slight concavity appearing on the far lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct high-contrast circular dark spots located in the mid-center of the right lobe's white field; several smaller, less defined clusters on the lower left lobe margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake-like marks) visible on the white field of the left lobe, varying in length and orientation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular indentation or missing tissue segment is located on the trailing edge of the left lobe immediately adjacent to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: A series of small, dark 'freckle' clusters concentrated along the bottom margin of both lobes where the white field meets the lower edge.
